> |           `-- GenomeWideSNP_6.cdf
Not correct, because the CDF is the "default" CDF, whereas the other

annotation files are for the "full" CDF (at least their tags claim
that - more below).

> `-- rawData
>     `-- run1

> #acs <- AromaCellSequenceFile$allocateFromCdf(cdf, tag='Full');
> #Ufl <- AromaUflFile$allocateFromCdf(cdf, tag='Full');
> #ufc <- AromaUfcFile$allocateFromCdf(cdf, tag='Full');
Those 4 commented lines *allocates* empty annotation files based on

the mapping of the (default) CDF (but with tags "full"). Anyway, you
don't want to do this. They are all empty and contains no annotation
information (which is why you get the error below). Instead you want
to download them from:
http://aroma-project.org/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_6/

Make sure to get the "Full" ones if you use the "Full" CDF, otherwise
the ones without the "Full" tag. That page also explains what
"default" and "full" means (which only applies to GenomeWideSNP_5 and
GenomeWideSNP_6).

> csR=AffymetrixCelSet$byName('run1', chipType='GenomeWideSNP_6')
> pair <- c(T="test1", N="test2")
> csR <- extract(csR, indexOf(csR, pair))

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error: length(uPos) > 0 is not TRUE
parts:
On Wed, Nov 30, 2011 at 6:54 PM, Peiyong <jiangp...@cuhk.edu.hk> wrote:
> Hi Henrik,
>
> Thank you very much.
>
> Originally I thought the *allocates* function will generate the ugp etc.
> files from the specified *.cdf.
>
> By the way after doASCRMAv2, if I want to export the log2R of test to
> control per probe including polymorphic and nonpolymorphic probes, how to do
> it ?

First, since allele-specific signals only exists for SNPs, you want to
work with total (="non-polymorphic") signals and allele B fractions
(BAFs), cf. "Note that by using this representation, we have a total
CN signal [...] for any locus, regardless of whether it is a SNP [or
not]" in Section '2.1 Parental-speciﬁc data at the locus level' of the
Paired PSCBS paper (Olshen et al. 2011)
[http://aroma-project.org/publications/]. This is what doCRMAv2() and
doASCRMAv2() returns.

To calculate non-polymorphic signals relative to do a reference, i.e.
total CN ratios (not on the log scale), see how-to page 'How to:
Calculate total copy number ratios from from total (non-polymorphic)
signals':

http://aroma-project.org/howtos/exportTotalCnRatioSet

The you can easily export those TCNs to tab-delimited text files using
writeDataFrame(), cf. http://aroma-project.org/howtos/writeDataFrame.

/Henrik
